mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, with potential for additive anticholinergic effects and possible modest CYP3A4 inhibition affecting empagliflozin metabolism; empagliflozin increases urinary glucose which may complicate urinary symptoms assessment.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic side effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation) and ensure adequate hydration given empagliflozin's diuretic effects; assess urinary symptoms periodically as empagliflozin increases glycosuria which may confound tolterodine efficacy assessment.
